policy: These records audit claims supplied in the conversation, not the motives or identities of their speakers. Failure to authenticate a quotation is not proof of deliberate fabrication. Original source conversations are not altered.

claims.supplied_claim: Maimonides rejected Jesus because an adversarial Satan was wholly foreign to Judaism.
claims.correction: Locate the alleged passage. Guide III.22 interprets Satan and permission; Laws of Kings 11 treats messianic criteria. Neither should be replaced with an unsourced composite objection.

claims.supplied_claim: Every later judgment of an earlier doctrine is anachronistic.
claims.correction: A medieval standard cannot exhaust the earlier historical range of beliefs. A later authority can nevertheless apply its own normative criteria; showing historical precedent does not compel doctrinal approval.

claims.supplied_claim: All Zoroastrians believe in two equal uncreated gods.
claims.correction: Different Iranian texts and interpretations arrange destructive spirit, beneficent spirit and Ahura Mazda differently. Compare a specified period and source rather than one timeless formula.

claims.supplied_claim: Isaiah 45:7 explicitly and conclusively identifies Zoroastrianism as its target.
claims.correction: The text names Cyrus and asserts divine sovereignty but does not name Zarathustra. Its contrast between peace and calamity should also be distinguished from a claim that God morally approves every evil act.

claims.supplied_claim: Job's narrative setting establishes the starting date of a continuous evolution through Ezekiel to Kabbalah.
claims.correction: Narrative setting, composition, redaction and surviving manuscript dates are distinct. A sequence selected for comparison is not automatically a demonstrated textual genealogy.

claims.supplied_claim: All scrolls were authored by one Essene community and reveal one doctrine.
claims.correction: The collection preserves different works, copies and rules. The 2024 commentary description explicitly discusses multiple settlements and textual forms.

claims.supplied_claim: Every Jewish adversary comes from the same rebellion story.
claims.correction: Job's accuser, the Community Rule's appointed spirits, Enoch's spirits of the giants and Jubilees' permitted Mastema have distinct narrative functions and origins.

claims.supplied_claim: Miriai is straightforwardly Jesus's Mandaean mother, born to Mandaean parents and seduced by a planetary spirit.
claims.correction: The consulted scholarly history and community translation response describe a Jewish-born Miriai. Possible literary connections with Mary traditions must be examined separately with exact textual locators.

claims.supplied_claim: The supplied detailed end-time sequence is the single unambiguous teaching of the Ginza Rabba.
claims.correction: A book, section, translation and treatment of variants are required. Soul-passage accounts and the end of the cosmos must not be merged solely because both concern judgment.

claims.supplied_claim: Esoteric knowledge universally replaces scripture, community and physical ritual.
claims.correction: Qumran interpretation works through scripture. Philip names ritual mysteries; the Hermetic prayer ends with an embrace and meal; Mandaean community accounts affirm embodied practice.

claims.supplied_claim: All compared traditions demand celibacy and rejection of family life.
claims.correction: The Mandaean community account affirms marriage. Text-specific and branch-specific practices are required before assigning a universal ascetic program.

claims.supplied_claim: Plato and all Gnostics describe the same evil material creator.
claims.correction: Timaeus calls the maker good; Ptolemy distinguishes a just intermediate maker from both highest Father and devil. Lower or derivative does not always mean independently evil.

claims.supplied_claim: The Treatise on the Resurrection says resurrection is an illusion.
claims.correction: The treatise affirms resurrection's reality while developing a transformative account. This differs from a simple denial of resurrection and requires its own comparison with bodily-resurrection doctrines.

claims.supplied_claim: The Gospel of Judas is a Nag Hammadi discovery.
claims.correction: It belongs to Codex Tchacos. Comparative relevance does not change the place of a text in its actual manuscript collection.

claims.supplied_claim: John defines every doubter of any miracle as Antichrist.
claims.correction: Distinguish the Gospel from 1 and 2 John. The selected epistolary tests concern Christ, Father and Son, and coming in flesh; a universal test of assent to every miracle is not their wording.

claims.supplied_claim: A growing Hasidic/Kabbalistic movement now accepts Jesus and the full Jesus-Scrolls bridge.
claims.correction: Named scholarly theses, individual appreciation and a declaration of cooperation do not establish a communal doctrinal shift. A dated institutional and speaker-level record is needed.

claims.supplied_claim: Eastern Christian churches are generally more Gnostic than Western churches.
claims.correction: Compare communion, liturgy and doctrine separately. The Coptic-Catholic declaration explicitly affirms incarnation and Trinity; age and geography do not prove demiurgical cosmology.

claims.supplied_claim: Only Mani includes both Buddha and Zoroaster.
claims.correction: Baha'i and Ahmadiyya community sources explicitly recognize both. Their theological interpretations of these figures are not thereby identical to Manichaeism or to the figures' original teachings.

claims.supplied_claim: Manichaean Elect and Hearers are necessarily hereditary castes, and all physical creation is only an evil mistake.
claims.correction: Different obligations do not alone establish hereditary caste. Manichaean cosmogony assigns the light powers a role in constructing a cosmos that serves the rescue of light.

claims.supplied_claim: Subtracting every theological difference proves one continuous ancient school.
claims.correction: Retain differences as variables. Test shared scripture, borrowing, institutional transmission and independent convergence rather than treating all similarity as one kind of evidence.

unverified_quotations.attributed_work: Jewish Literature Between the Bible and the Mishnah
unverified_quotations.opening_supplied: The nature of the conflict is eschatological rather than ontological.
unverified_quotations.finding: No edition, page or matching original passage was established. Do not publish the long supplied paragraph as a direct quotation.

unverified_quotations.opening_supplied: For it is in this period that we find the emergence of a clearly defined kingdom of evil
unverified_quotations.finding: The exact supplied wording was not authenticated. Replace it with a sourced paraphrase of a consulted passage or recover an edition and page.

unverified_quotations.opening_supplied: The Rule of the Community from Qumran provides perhaps the most striking example
unverified_quotations.finding: No matching page was established. The primary Community Rule comparison does not depend on attributing these words to VanderKam.

unverified_quotations.opening_supplied: Maimonides' philosophical project was largely an attempt to sanitize Judaism
unverified_quotations.finding: This severe characterization was not authenticated as Scholem's wording. Do not use quotation marks or his authority to present it as established.

unverified_quotations.attributed_work: Christian Origins and the Question of God
unverified_quotations.opening_supplied: The New Testament portrayal of Satan as the ruler of this world is not a deviation from Judaism
unverified_quotations.finding: The cited label identifies a series rather than a precise volume and page. The exact text remains unverified.

unverified_quotations.finding: The supplied wording was not authenticated. A primary Tanya passage is used for the bounded later-mysticism comparison instead.
